release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.49 reworks Drops into a compact, no-scroll desktop workspace. The old stacked hero, metrics, oversized inline editor, readiness explainer, radar cards, and planner/calendar/archive surfaces are removed from the main Drops view. Drops now uses one dense toolbar, a viewport-paginated drop list, and a selected-drop inspector with the launch details and actions that matter. Add/Edit moves into a compact Tachyon modal while preserving the existing canonical drop storage, Tasks handoff, Preflight, Arm Drop, watch, duplicate, delete, import, and export behavior. A final runtime remount guard prevents older compatibility renderers from deleting the compact workspace after navigation. Chromium regression coverage seeds 24 drops and verifies no vertical or horizontal scrolling, hidden legacy surfaces, viewport pagination, retained actions and modal fields, alongside the full browser suite and 120-task soak.
